anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck issues.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows no active trades or profit/loss, which might indicate inactivity or issues with strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Evaluate and potentially restart AI components to ensure they are actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Review and test the active trading strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and aligned with market conditions.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough analysis of CPU usage to identify and address the root cause of high load averages.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to performance degradation and system instability, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Restart the AI modules and monitor their activity to ensure they are operational and contributing to trading decisions.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity could result in missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Perform a review of the trading strategies and their market alignment to ensure they are capable of executing trades effectively.
recommendations.rationale: Inactive trading strategies may indicate misalignment with current market conditions or technical issues.
